extraction_notes: Extracted plotted catalytic-performance points from SI Figures S24, S25, S27 and S46. SI Figure S26 was skipped as an Arrhenius plot. SI Figure S45 was skipped because it reports mean surface residence time rather than CO2 conversion, selectivity, or methanol formation rate/STY. Operando/transient normalized MS/IR profiles and characterization/DFT figures were skipped. CO STY values in SI Figures S24, S25b and S27b are included in notes because the provided schema has no dedicated CO-STY field; methanol STY/rate values are in methanol_sty. Values are read from plotted markers/bars and carry qualifier '~'.
